Banana Popsicles
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, February 10, 2010 - 6:40pm

Ingredients




1 pkt instant banana pudding mix (3.4 oz.)
2 cups skim milk
1 banana cut into pieces

Preparation

1 Mix pudding mix and milk together. Add cut up banana to pudding and blend evenly. 2 Spoon enough pudding/bananas into popsicle cups to cover bottom. 3 Periodically tap the cups to get any air pockets out. Freeze till set and enjoy! 4 Description: "These sweet treats take only 10 minutes to make! Give them time to freeze. Whip some up for an afternoon snack the kids (or you) will love." Yield: 7 popsicles
